# EXCLUSIVE DISTRIBUTION AGREEMENT

This Exclusive Distribution Agreement (this "**Agreement**") is entered into as of November 15, 2023 (the "**Effective Date**") by and between **Velloran Instruments, Inc.**, a Delaware corporation with its principal place of business at 4410 Calder Ridge Parkway, Newark, Delaware 19713 ("**Supplier**"), and **Harrow Creek Distribution LLC**, a Delaware limited liability company with its principal place of business at 2275 Fallon Mill Road, Suite 300, King of Prussia, Pennsylvania 19406 ("**Distributor**"). Supplier and Distributor are each a "**Party**" and together the "**Parties**."

## RECITALS

A. Supplier designs and manufactures precision measurement instruments and related products.

B. Distributor is in the business of marketing, selling and distributing industrial and laboratory instrumentation to commercial and institutional customers.

C. Supplier wishes to appoint Distributor as its exclusive distributor of the Products in the Territory, and Distributor wishes to accept that appointment, on the terms and conditions of this Agreement.

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants in this Agreement and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are acknowledged, the Parties agree as follows:

## 1. DEFINITIONS

1.1 "**Affiliate**" means, with respect to a Person, any other Person that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by or is under common control with that Person, where "control" means ownership of more than fifty percent (50%) of the voting equity of a Person or the power to direct its management and policies.

1.2 "**Business Day**" means any day other than a Saturday, Sunday or day on which commercial banks in Wilmington, Delaware are authorized or required by law to close.

1.3 "**Change of Control**" means, with respect to Distributor, (a) any transaction or series of related transactions that results in the sale, transfer or other disposition, directly or indirectly, of more than fifty percent (50%) of the equity interests or voting power of Distributor; (b) any merger, consolidation or reorganization of Distributor after which the holders of Distributor's equity interests immediately before the transaction hold fifty percent (50%) or less of the equity interests or voting power of the surviving entity; or (c) the sale of all or substantially all of Distributor's assets.

1.4 "**Confidential Information**" has the meaning given in Section 12.1.

1.5 "**Customer**" means any end user or reseller to which Distributor sells Products in the Territory.

1.6 "**Exhibits**" means the exhibits attached to this Agreement, as amended from time to time in accordance with Section 19.2.

1.7 "**First Amendment**" means the first written amendment to this Agreement executed by both Parties in accordance with Section 19.2.

1.8 "**Minimum Purchase Requirement**" has the meaning given in Section 5.1.

1.9 "**Person**" means any individual, corporation, limited liability company, partnership, trust, governmental authority or other entity.

1.10 "**Products**" means the products listed in Exhibit A, as updated by the Parties in writing.

1.11 "**Side Letter**" means any letter agreement executed by both Parties that supplements this Agreement with respect to exclusivity and non-competition.

1.12 "**Territory**" means the States of Delaware, Maryland, New Jersey and Pennsylvania.

1.13 "**Trademarks**" means the trademarks, trade names and logos of Supplier used in connection with the Products, as designated by Supplier from time to time.

## 2. APPOINTMENT

2.1 **Exclusive Appointment.** Subject to the terms of this Agreement, Supplier appoints Distributor as its exclusive distributor of the Products in the Territory during the Term, and Distributor accepts that appointment. During the Term, Supplier shall not appoint any other distributor, agent or sales representative for the Products in the Territory, and shall not itself sell Products directly to Customers located in the Territory except as provided in Section 2.3.

2.2 **No Rights Outside the Territory.** Distributor has no right to market or sell Products outside the Territory, and Supplier reserves all rights to appoint distributors and sell Products outside the Territory. Distributor shall refer to Supplier any inquiries it receives for Products for delivery outside the Territory.

2.3 **Reserved Accounts.** Supplier may sell Products directly to the federal government accounts listed in Exhibit C (the "**Reserved Accounts**"), wherever located. Distributor shall receive no commission on sales to Reserved Accounts.

2.4 **Independent Contractor.** Distributor purchases Products for its own account and resells them in its own name. Nothing in this Agreement creates a partnership, joint venture, franchise or agency relationship between the Parties, and neither Party has authority to bind the other.

## 3. TERM AND RENEWAL

3.1 **Initial Term.** This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues for an initial term of three (3) years from the Effective Date, ending November 14, 2026 (the "**Initial Term**"), unless terminated earlier in accordance with Section 15.

3.2 **Renewal.** This Agreement shall renew for one (1) additional term of three (3) years (the "**Renewal Term**" and, together with the Initial Term, the "**Term**") only if Distributor delivers to Supplier written notice of its election to renew (a "**Renewal Notice**") at least ninety (90) days prior to the expiration of the Initial Term. This Agreement does not renew automatically. If Distributor does not deliver a Renewal Notice within the time required by this Section 3.2, this Agreement shall expire at the end of the Initial Term.

3.3 **Renewal Pricing.** Pricing for the Renewal Term shall be as set out in Exhibit B as in effect on the first day of the Renewal Term, subject to adjustment under Section 4.3.

## 4. PRICING AND PAYMENT

4.1 **Prices.** Distributor s

5.1 **Minimum Purchases.** In each contract year of the Term, Distributor shall purchase Products with an aggregate net invoice value of not less than the amount stated for that contract year in Exhibit B (the "**Minimum Purchase Requirement**").

5.2 **Shortfall.** If Distributor fails to meet the Minimum Purchase Requirement in any contract year, Supplier may, as its sole remedy, by written notice delivered within sixty (60) days after the end of that contract year, (a) convert Distributor's appointment under Section 2.1 to a non-exclusive appointment for the remainder of the Term, or (b) terminate this Agreement under Section 15.3.

6.1 **Purchase Orders.** Distributor shall order Products by issuing written purchase orders ("**Purchase Orders**") to Supplier. 6.4 **Conflicting Terms.** Any terms in a Purchase Order, acknowledgment or invoice that are additional to or inconsistent with this Agreement are of no effect.

7.1 Distributor shall use commercially reasonable efforts to promote, market and sell the Products throughout the Territory.

7.2 Distributor shall maintain a trained sales and technical support staff sufficient to market the Products and provide first-line technical support to Customers.

7.3 Distributor shall maintain an inventory of Products sufficient to meet reasonably anticipated Customer demand in the Territory.

7.4 Distributor shall comply with all applicable laws in connection with its performance under this Agreement, including export control and anti-corruption laws.

7.5 Distributor shall not modify the Products or their labeling or packaging without Supplier's prior written consent.

## 8. SUPPLIER OBLIGATIONS

8.1 Supplier shall provide Distributor, at no charge, reasonable quantities of sales literature, technical documentation and demonstration materials for the Products.

8.2 Supplier shall provide initial and periodic product training for Distributor's sales and technical personnel.

8.3 Supplier shall refer to Distributor all inquiries it receives from prospective Customers located in the Territory, other than Reserved Accounts.

8.4 Supplier shall give Distributor at least one hundred twenty (120) days' prior written notice of the discontinuation of any Product.

## 9. TRADEMARKS

9.1 Supplier grants Distributor a non-exclusive, non-transferable, royalty-free license during the Term to use the Trademarks in the Territory solely to advertise and sell the Products, in accordance with Supplier's trademark guidelines.

9.2 Distributor acquires no ownership interest in the Trademarks. All goodwill arising from Distributor's use of the Trademarks inures to Supplier. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement, Distributor shall cease all use of the Trademarks, subject to Section 16.2.

10.1 **Product Warranty.** Supplier warrants to Distributor and to each Customer that the Products will conform to the specifications in Exhibit A and be free from defects in materials and workmanship for twelve (12) months after delivery to the Customer, not to exceed eighteen (18) months after delivery to Distributor.

10.2 **Remedy.** Supplier's sole obligation, and Distributor's exclusive remedy, for breach of the warranty in Section 10.1 is the repair or replacement of the nonconforming Product or, if repair or replacement is not commercially practicable, a refund or credit of the price paid.

10.3 **Mutual Warranties.** Each Party represents and warrants that it is duly organized and in good standing, that it has full power and authority to enter into and perform this Agreement, and that this Agreement constitutes its legal, valid and binding obligation.

10.4 **Disclaimer.** EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET OUT IN THIS SECTION 10, SUPPLIER MAKES NO OTHER WARRANTIES, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING ANY IMPLIED WARRANTY OF MERCHANTABILITY OR FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.

## 11. INDEMNIFICATION

11.1 **By Supplier.** Supplier shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Distributo

14.4 **Successors.** This Agreement binds and benefits the Parties and their respective permitted successors and assigns.

# Re: Exclusivity and Non-Competition Side Letter – Exclusive Distribution Agreement dated as of November 15, 2023

Dear Mr. Esterly:

This letter agreement (this "**Side Letter**") is delivered in connection with the Exclusive Distribution Agreement dated as of November 15, 2023 (the "**Distribution Agreement**") between Velloran Instruments, Inc. ("**Supplier**") and Harrow Creek Distribution LLC ("**Distributor**"). Supplier and Distributor are each a "**Party**" and together the "**Parties**." This Side Letter is the "Side Letter" referred to in Sections 1.11 and 19.4 of the Distribution Agreement. It sets out additional understandings between the Parties about Distributor's exclusive appointment and Distributor's non-competition obligations.

In consideration of Supplier's continued appointment of Distributor as its exclusive distributor of the Products, the mutual covenants below and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are acknowledged, the Parties agree as follows:

## 1. Definitions

1.1 **Defined Terms.** Capitalized terms used but not defined in this Side Letter have the meanings given to them in the Distribution Agreement, except that "**Territory**" means Delaware, Maryland, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, New York and Virginia.

1.2 **Competing Products.** "**Competing Products**" means any precision measurement instruments, laboratory balances, calibration standards, or related accessories or consumables that are substantially similar in function to, or are marketed as substitutes for, any of the Products. Products manufactured or supplied by Supplier are not Competing Products.

1.3 **Restricted Period.** "**Restricted Period**" means the Term of the Distribution Agreement and the eighteen (18) month period immediately following the expiration or termination of the Distribution Agreement for any reason.

## 2. Non-Competition

2.1 **Covenant.** During the Restricted Period, Distributor shall not, directly or indirectly, and shall cause its Affiliates not to, market, promote, sell, distribute or act as a sales agent or representative for any Competing Products in the Territory.

2.2 **Indirect Activities.** Distributor shall not avoid the restriction in Section 2.1 by acting through any Affiliate, member, manager, employee or other Person. Distributor shall not knowingly supply Competing Products to any Person for resale in the Territory during the Restricted Period.

2.3 **Passive Investments.** Section 2.1 does not prohibit Distributor or its Affiliates from owning, as a passive investment, two percent (2%) or less of any class of publicly traded securities of any Person.

2.4 **Reasonableness.** Distributor acknowledges that the restrictions in this Section 2 are reasonable in scope, duration and geographic area. Distributor also acknowledges that these restrictions are necessary to protect Supplier's goodwill, Confidential Information and investment in the distribution of the Products, and that Supplier would not continue Distributor's exclusive appointment without them.

## 3. Exclusivity

3.1 **Confirmation of Appointment.** Supplier confirms that Distributor's appointment as Supplier's exclusive distributor of the Products continues as set forth in Section 2.1 of the Distribution Agreement, subject to Section 2.3 (Reserved Accounts) and Section 5.2 (Shortfall) of the Distribution Agreement. This Side Letter does not modify Section 2.1 of the Distribution Agreement.

3.2 **Minimum Performance.** Distributor acknowledges that its exclusive appointment remains conditioned on its satisfaction of the Minimum Purchase Requirement in accordance with Section 5 and Exhibit B of the Distribution Agreement.

3.3 **Notice of Competing Opportunities.** During the Term, Distributor shall promptly notify Supplier in writing of any request it receives from a Customer or prospective Customer to supply Competing Products in the Territory.

## 4. Remedies

4.1 **Equitable Relief.** Distributor acknowledges that a breach or threatened breach of Section 2 would cause Supplier irreparable harm for which monetary damages would be an inadequate remedy. Supplier may therefore seek temporary, preliminary and permanent injunctive relief to restrain any such breach in the courts specified in Section 6, without posting bond, in addition to any other remedies available at law or in equity.

4.2 **Tolling.** If Distributor breaches Section 2, the post-term portion of the Restricted Period is extended by the period during which the breach continues.

4.3 **Termination Right.** A breach of Section 2 during the Term is a material breach of the Distribution Agreement for purposes of Section 15.1 of the Distribution Agreement.

## 5. Term and Survival

5.1 This Side Letter takes effect on the date first written above. It remains in effect for the Term of the Distribution Agreement and thereafter for so long as any obligation under Section 2 or Section 4 remains in effect.

5.2 Sections 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 and 7 survive the expiration or termination of the Distribution Agreement.

## 6. Governing Law and Forum

# WAREHOUSE AND FULFILLMENT SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Warehouse and Fulfillment Services Agreement (this "**Agreement**") is entered into as of February 1, 2024 (the "**Effective Date**") by and between **Saltmarsh Logistics LLC**, a Delaware limited liability company with its principal place of business at 615 Pigeon Point Road, New Castle, Delaware 19720 ("**Provider**"), and **Harrow Creek Distribution LLC**, a Delaware limited liability company with its principal place of business at 2275 Fallon Mill Road, Suite 300, King of Prussia, Pennsylvania 19406 ("**Customer**"). Provider and Customer are each a "**Party**" and together the "**Parties**."

## RECITALS

A. Provider operates public and contract warehouse facilities and provides storage, order fulfillment and related logistics services.

B. Customer distributes industrial and laboratory instrumentation and wishes to engage Provider to store certain of its inventory and to fulfill certain customer orders, on the terms of this Agreement.

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants in this Agreement and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are acknowledged, the Parties agree as follows:

## 1. DEFINITIONS

1.1 "**Facility**" means Provider's warehouse located at 615 Pigeon Point Road, New Castle, Delaware 19720, or any other facility Customer approves in writing under Section 3.3.

1.2 "**Goods**" means the inventory that Customer or its suppliers deliver to the Facility for storage and handling under this Agreement.

1.3 "**Order**" means an instruction from Customer, transmitted through the WMS or by other agreed means, directing Provider to pick, pack and ship Goods to a consignee.

1.4 "**Rate Schedule**" means the schedule of fees attached as Schedule 1, as amended in accordance with Section 5.3.

1.5 "**Services**" means the receiving, storage, inventory management, order fulfillment, shipping and related services described in Section 2 and Schedule 1.

1.6 "**WMS**" means Provider's web-based warehouse management system.

## 2. SERVICES

2.1 **Receiving.** Provider shall receive inbound shipments of Goods at the Facility during its normal receiving hours, inspect each shipment for visible damage and count discrepancies against the bill of lading or advance shipping notice, and record received Goods in the WMS within one (1) Business Day after receipt. Provider shall promptly notify Customer of any visible damage, shortage or overage.

2.2 **Storage.** Provider shall store the Goods in a clean, dry, secure and climate-controlled area of the Facility, maintained at a temperature of between 60°F and 80°F and a relative humidity not exceeding 60%, segregated from goods of Provider's other customers and identifiable as Customer's property.

2.3 **Order Fulfillment.** Provider shall pick, pack and tender for shipment each Order received by 2:00 p.m. Eastern Time on a Business Day on that same Business Day, and each other Order on the next Business Day. Provider shall ship Orders using the carriers and service levels designated by Customer.

2.4 **Packaging and Labeling.** Provider shall ship Goods in the manufacturer's original packaging, with the manufacturer's labeling intact, together with any packing slip or shipping label generated for the Order. Provider shall not open, repackage, relabel or otherwise alter Goods or their manufacturer packaging or labeling except as Customer specifically directs in writing.

2.5 **Returns.** Provider shall receive, inspect and record customer returns in accordance with Customer's written return procedures and hold returned Goods in a separate location pending Customer's disposition instructions.

2.6 **Inventory Reporting and Counts.** Provider shall give Customer continuous access to real-time inventory data through the WMS. Provider shall conduct a full physical inventory count once per calendar year on a date agreed with Customer, and cycle counts as reasonably requested by Customer, and shall reconcile any variances with Customer within ten (10) Business Days.

2.7 **Performance Standards.** Provider shall achieve (a) order accuracy of at least 99.5%, (b) on-time shipment of at least 99% of Orders under Section 2.3, and (c) annual inventory accuracy of at least 99.7% by unit, each measured monthly. If Provider fails to meet any standard in two (2) consecutive months, the Parties shall meet within ten (10) Business Days to agree on a corrective action plan.

## 3. FACILITY AND PERSONNEL

3.1 **Facility Standards.** Provider shall maintain the Facility in good repair and in compliance with applicable law, with alarm and fire-suppression systems, controlled access and video surveillance of storage and shipping areas.

3.2 **Personnel.** Provider shall perform the Services using its own trained employees or supervised contractors and is responsible for their acts and omissions.

3.3 **Relocation.** Provider shall not move Goods to any facility other than the Facility without Customer's prior written approval, except temporarily in an emergency to protect the Goods, in which case Provider shall notify Customer within twenty-four (24) hours.

3.4 **Access and Audit.** Customer and its designees may inspect the Facility and Goods, and audit Provider's records relating to the Services, during normal business hours on two (2) Business Days' notice.

## 4. TERM AND TERMINATION

4.1 **Term.** This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues for an initial term of one (1) year. It renews automatically for successive one (1) year terms unless terminated in accordance with this Section 4.

4.2 **Termination for Convenience.** Either Party may terminate this Agreement at any time, for any reason or no reason, by giving the other Party at least sixty (60) days' prior written notice.

4.3 **Termination for Cause.** Either Party may terminate this Agreement on written notice if the other Party materially breaches this Agreement and fails to cure
